rationale: All 6 acceptance criteria and the no-commingling constraint pass per the acceptance lens. Blind and edge-case lenses independently converged on one real gap: the guard `if (!config.baseUrl) return;` is a falsy check, so a whitespace-only baseUrl (e.g. ' ') is truthy and bypasses the guard, letting cold start proceed against an effectively-unconfigured target — the same failure class this fix is meant to close. One finding (CR-001) raised to patch/major. Other blind-lens notes (no debug log on silent skip; no test for ConfigLoader.load itself throwing; an unverified claim in the guard comment about per-hook invocation; unclear test-mock relevance) are pre-existing-scope or stylistic, not blocking — recorded as deferred, not emitted as findings. Standards check: commit message matches Conventional Commits format in git-workflow.md; no security-patterns.md guide present to check against; husky pre-commit (lint/typecheck/secrets) passed clean on the commit.

findings.problem: The baseUrl guard uses a plain falsy check (`if (!config.baseUrl) return;`), so a whitespace-only string (e.g. `' '`) is truthy and bypasses the guard.
findings.impact: A profile with a whitespace-only baseUrl still proceeds to daemon cold-start with an effectively-unconfigured target, reintroducing the same failure class (unnecessary spawn attempt / bad target URL) this fix is meant to close.
findings.recommendation: Trim before checking: `if (!config.baseUrl?.trim()) return;` (independently identified by both the blind and edge-case review lenses).
